rootCause: In src/server/store.ts within the cancelByToken function, the waiting list promotion selects the last element of the waiting list array (waiting.at(-1)) instead of the first element (waiting[0] or waiting.at(0)). This causes LIFO (Last-In-First-Out) behavior where the most recently added waiting list guest is promoted rather than the first person who joined the queue.
targetedTest: Cancellation promotes incorrect guest from waiting list
